name: Minazuki Shou
source:
Shou is the main antagonist of Persona 4 Ultimax, claiming to be behind all of the events. Sho is a young man with a vicious streak and an interest in fighting. He is a puerile, flippant, hotheaded and anxious young man. He is a loner at heart and calls friendship with others "useless", viewing people as too weak to rely on. Shou is described as a misanthrope, loathing everything and everyone, and wishing for a world where only he lives. He also has a tendency to make puns so bad even [url=/c46798]Yukiko[/url] or [url=/c52190]Teddie[/url] can't fix them/find them funny.

[Edited from [url=http://megamitensei.wikia.com/wiki/Sho_Minazuki]Megami Tensei Wiki[/url]]

[Spoiler]He wields the [Url=https://megamitensei.fandom.com/wiki/Tsukuyomi]Tsukiyomi[/url] persona, the deification of the moon and the ruler of the night in Shintoism.[/spoiler]
